mainEntity.name: What is the best way to use AI to build a sales funnel without making it confusing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Begin with a funnel map showing the audience, offer, opt-in resource, follow-up sequence, and desired next action. Run My AI Business describes connected examples involving lead magnets, opt-in pages, bridge pages, thank-you pages, email sequences, and campaign planning. Context: AI can draft each component, but disconnected copy or unclear handoffs can produce a confusing customer experience. Key factors: - One specific audience and problem - Consistent promise across pages and emails - Delivery of the lead magnet - Measurement of each step Practical guidance: Ask AI to create a requirements checklist before drafting copy, then review every claim and link. Test the opt-in, delivery, and follow-up sequence with a small audience before promoting it broadly. Run My AI Business can help owners understand the complete funnel rather than treating each asset as an isolated task.
acceptedAnswer.description: Map the audience, problem, offer, opt-in resource, follow-up, and next action before generating copy. Keep the promise consistent across every page and email, test delivery and links, and review claims before promotion.
